In this vignette, you will learn see a basic workflow with the package for one individual. 

### Setup OAuth for Sentinel-2

After installing, you should create an account on https://shapps.dataspace.copernicus.eu/dashboard/#/account/settings and create an OAuth Client there. 

If you did this, set up your `.Renviron` file, that includes the environmental variables for CDSE and the GPS data directory. 


``` r
CDSE_CLIENT_ID=myid
CDSE_CLIENT_SECRET=mysecret
GPS_SMB_ROOT="//myserver/GPS"
```

After adapting the files, read in the environment variables by calling


``` r
readRenviron(".Renviron")

# check
Sys.getenv("CDSE_CLIENT_ID", "")
```

To fetch satellite imagery from CDSE, we need to create an OAuthClient with the credentials from our account. 
These are the credentials you have to put in `.Renviron`.


``` r
oauth <- CDSE::GetOAuthClient(id = Sys.getenv("CDSE_CLIENT_ID", ""),
                              secret = Sys.getenv("CDSE_CLIENT_SECRET", ""))

```

### Read GPS data files

You can use `read_gps_csv()` to automatically read in all `*.csv` files. The function will look for 
files in your `GPS_SMB_ROOT` directory. 


``` r
gps_data <- read_gps_csv(pattern = "^Z.*\\.csv$") |> 
  dplyr::select(subject, timestamp, lat, lon, direction, speed)
```

### Fetch data from CDSE

After that, we can simply retrieve the NDVI and landuse data from the CDSE/AWS servers for participant Z313.


``` r
gps_data_Z313 <- gps_data |> 
  filter(subject=="Z313")

gps_data_Z313 <- gps_data_Z313 |>
  mutate_aoi_h3(lat = "lat", lon = "lon") |>
  fetch_ndvi(
    from = min(gps_data_Z313$timestamp),
    to   = max(gps_data_Z313$timestamp),
    out_dir = "output/.ndvi",
    client = oauth,
    res_m = 10
  ) |>
  attach_ndvi() |>
  fetch_landuse(out_dir = "output/.landuse") |>
  attach_landuse()
```

### Simple visualization


``` r
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(gps_data_Z313 |> select(h3, ndvi_mean, geometry) |> unique(),
       aes(fill = ndvi_mean)) +
  geom_sf(color = NA) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    midpoint = 0.5,
    low = "brown",
    mid = "#E7D6A4",
    high = "darkgreen",
    limits = c(0,1)
  )+
  labs(fill = "NDVI")+
  # remove coordinates for pricavy
  theme_void()
```


### Visualization with `cartographr`


``` r
library(ggplot2)
library(cartographr)

osm <- get_osmdata(bbox = attr(gps_data_Z313, "traktr_aoi")  |> sf::st_bbox())
set_attribution(F)
set_output_size(size = "A3", orientation = "landscape")

{
  p <- osm |> plot_map("swiss") 
  pm <- p +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()+
    geom_sf(data= gps_data_Z313 |>
              select(geometry, ndvi_mean, frac_green_core, h3) |> 
              unique(),
            aes(fill = ndvi_mean), 
            color = NA, alpha = 0.6)+
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "brown",midpoint = 0.5,
      mid = "#E7D6A4",
      high = "darkgreen",
      name = "values",
      limits = c(0,1),
      breaks = c(0,0.5,1)
    )+
    cartographr:::adjust_viewport(p)+
    cartographr::theme_infomap()
}

save_map(pm, filename = "output/Z313_ndvi.pdf")

ggplot(gps_data_Z313 |> select(h3, ndvi_mean, geometry) |> unique(),
       aes(fill = ndvi_mean)) +
  geom_sf(color = NA) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    midpoint = 0.5,
    low = "brown",
    mid = "#E7D6A4",
    high = "darkgreen",
    limits = c(0,1)
  )+
  labs(fill = "NDVI")+
  # remove coordinates for pricavy
  theme_void()
```
